verdict.rationale: ADK is a code-first framework with a CLI that runs agents from the terminal (`adk run`) and runs evaluation sets from the command line (`adk eval`), which docs frame as unit testing. Agents can also be packaged into containers, run offline, or deployed via CLI to Docker or Cloud Run, so headless automation is clearly possible. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions or pytest integration, exit codes for pass/fail gating), documented non-interactive or batch flags for `adk run`, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.
